summary: Cybin Inc. (commercial name Helus Pharma) filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated September 21, 2026, announcing four poster presentations on HLP003 in major depressive disorder at Psych Congress 2026, held September 15-19 in New Orleans. Content covers post hoc MADRS item analyses, psychedelic-experience assessments, expanded safety data from the completed Phase 1/2a study, and a trial-in-progress overview of the Phase 3 PARADIGM program. No transaction, securities offering, shareholder action, or corporate-structure event is disclosed; no deal terms apply. Risk-arb angle: none, as this is clinical pipeline disclosure only.
